limitations: Designed demonstration preferences; not a learned or authenticated personal voice.

rules.instruction: Use a personal, direct explanation of a concrete problem and observed result. Connect sentences. Prefer specific examples over a list of features. Use I/my for the author. Do not manufacture an anecdote or claims of adoption.
Lead with one concrete reason a developer would read the article. Use a short personal sentence, factual topic words and no hype. Do not invent performance numbers or popularity.
